snippet.title: Samurai GUNN 2 is BACK!!
snippet.description:
Samurai GUNN 2 is relaunching after 3 years of intense development by our small team. We rebuilt the game from scratch in our own custom engine to ensure the games runs fast, the netcode is reliable, and we can continue to update the game with more content for years to come.

Also, we are releasing Samurai GUNN 2: Free Edition! It includes the full game (all modes and unlocks!), with limited character select.

⚔️ Samurai GUNN 2 on Steam: https://dub.sh/gunn
‼️ Press Kit: https://presskit.scrambler.media/samurai-gunn-2
💌 Contact: adam@scrambler.media
